select u.user_id as "userId", u.nick_name as "nickName", u.user_name as "userName", u.status as "status" from sys_user u where u.nick_name = #{nickName} and u.del_flag = '0' order by (case when u.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end), u.user_id limit 1

select distinct u.user_id as "userId", u.nick_name as "nickName", u.user_name as "userName", u.status as "status" from proj_leader l join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id where l.del_flag = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.nick_name
